reviewOutcome: The national Geoportal's LMB Parcel data layer was found through its live public layer catalog, and Butuan City planning material was found. No safe anonymous Butuan parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified, so runtime qualification remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Cebuano discovery queries were executed. Geoportal HTML/JavaScript and /layers/fetchlayers returned successfully; the catalog identified denr_parcel_data / Parcel data / LMB. A bounded EPSG:4326 GetFeatureInfo request around the exact WUP point and WMS GetCapabilities both timed out. Official Butuan planning and LRA procedure pages were reviewed. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Butuan City's Planning and Development Department is evidenced as a local planning/map custodian. LMB is evidenced as the national source agency for the Geoportal Parcel data layer. No local Butuan registry/cadastre endpoint or procedure exposing parcel geometry was established.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID when independently verified
scopeLimits: No exact-point or map-extent absence inference; the WUP point remains exactly [8.96303598990931, 125.541023764139] in latitude/longitude order.
The national layer catalog entry is not proof of Butuan parcel coverage.
No parcel owner, address, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or contact fields were requested or retained.
No registry, catalog, runtime configuration, queue, identity ledger, or global report was changed.
uncertainty: The Geoportal WMS may respond in a future attempt or through another public request path; timeouts do not establish parcel absence. Native parcel identity, schema, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; no source integration or admission.
